description_en: Invoke this API to obtain the execution result of a data table download job.
description_zh: 调用该接口获取数据表数据下载任务的执行结果
kebab_example: aliyun iot get-download-file --context xxx_xxx --iot-instance-id iot-cn-npk1u000000 --long-job-id 62d949808bc742187xxxxxx --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetDownloadFile

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the invocation will fail.
- If there is no <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).
parameters.description_zh:

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
